content: {"like":["Appreciates strong, character‑driven performances in contemporary dramas (e.g., Felicity Jones in *True Story*).","Values well‑crafted, clever writing and top‑notch acting in modern biographical or historical dramas (e.g., Daniel Radcliffe in *The Last Duel*).","Enjoys innovative first‑person storytelling with dynamic action in low‑budget sci‑fi (e.g., *The Last Exorcism Part II*).","Seeks genre‑blending, high‑concept action films that subvert expectations (e.g., *Terminator Genisys*).","Prefers visually striking, concept‑heavy action‑thrillers with strong lead performances (e.g., *Only God Forgives*)."],"dislike":["Dislikes miscasting and weak performances in contemporary dramas (e.g., Jonah Hill in *True Story*).","Criticizes shallow, incomplete documentary coverage of complex subjects (e.g., *Going Clear*).","Finds anachronistic dialogue and weak subplots ruin period or historical dramas (e.g., *The Last Duel*).","Rejects low‑budget, disorienting first‑person action films with poor production values (e.g., *The Last Exorcism Part II*).","Detests thin, poorly paced action‑thrillers with minimal character development (e.g., *Only God Forgives*)."]}
